title: Jimmy Dean Hearty Sausage Mini Quiches
description: These sausage mini quiches are easy to make with whatever vegetables you have on hand for a pleasing addition to a brunch buffet.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package Regular Flavor Jimmy Dean Pork Sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained
0.75 cup shredded Cheddar, mozzarella or provolone cheese
1 cup thinly sliced mushrooms or yellow squash
1 cup frozen Southern-style hash brown potatoes or diced, pre-baked red potatoes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). In a large mixing bowl, combine eggs, milk or water, cheese, salt, and pepper; set aside. Heat olive oil or butter in a large skillet; sauté onions and any optional vegetables desired until vegetables are tender. Add vegetables and sausage to egg mixture; stir well.

Place 12 foil baking cups into the cupcake pan. Distribute sausage-and-egg mixture evenly into baking cups. Bake until eggs are set, about 22 minutes. Remove from the oven. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese if desired.
